completed.end: Jonathan escorts the child home safely. Her mother stands beside them while her voice repeats from the closed water store. Q records the sound; its cause remains unknown.

stagingRevision.note: Q remains visible for his later lines; original text, audio, choices and released v1 bytes preserved.

completed.end: Neri water emergency resolved with four material outcomes and two independent truth/cooperation outcomes. Tao or Q may die, or all survive with half/no shipment. No universal outcome selected.

Two-community water negotiation ends in hill control, temporary need-based distribution, or earned shared management. Mei survives only with evacuation or treatment. Earlier casualties and An’s independent testimony persist.

Jonathan and An isolate the damaged pipe and return unharmed. Player recovers a sample, a copied route, or both by abandoning the anchored rope. Prior survivors, promises, agreement and stored water persist in the confirmed continuity snapshot. Jonathan learns to respect An’s stop signal and expertise.

Western station expedition completed. Both return safely; stored water and prior continuity unchanged. Player either takes part by draining empty lower archive (door/records lost), leaves part preserving door/records, or after inspection braces with retained rope / destroys lightsaber if rope lost, preserving records temporarily and committing to repair before next storm. Recovered part repairs home pipe but valve stays closed. Sample routes show unsafe water; no-sample route remains untested.

defaults.coverageNote: New learner: no assessed-known export. The 80% floor measures membership only in the supplied inventory plus proposed glossary, not mastery. All additional basic scaffolding is annotated and audited privately; never promote it to familiar to pass a check.
defaults.teaserArtwork: ImageGen first, then video. Use Jon’s approved likeness reference; shonen-anime Jedi art is welcome (David, 2026-10-26). Keep generated video at or below $0.15 total per clip, including retries.
defaults.choiceConsequences: Meaningful danger, morally ambiguous informed choices, survival and material endings can change. Preserve resulting losses; do not silently reconverge them away.
defaults.teaserDialogue: Every opening teaser includes one cool or epic spoken English phrase by Jon or another character, foreshadowing the highest-tension moment. ImageGen first; exact words once, no extra speech. User preference 2026-10-27.

continuity: The child from episode 1 is safe with her mother.
Jonathan, An and Q travel to Neri for water; Min is an adult with an ill wife; Tao is the pump worker.
Episode 2 has four outcomes: Tao dead/all water/Q alive; everyone alive/half water; everyone alive/no water/Tao offers a lead; Tao alive/all water/Q destroyed and recording lost.
An agrees to answer publicly alongside Jonathan if he tells the truth; she refuses to support concealment and gives her own account.
The source of the repeated voice remains unexplained. Do not resurrect Tao or Q or restore the lost recording without an explicitly selected compatible route.

Episode 3: three preparations from pump inspection, both-community hearing, voluntary household reserve contribution and evacuation. Shared management requires inspection and hearing and costs four buckets.
Mei survives only if evacuated early or treated with four buckets; otherwise she dies. Do not resurrect her.
Hill control costs six buckets; emergency distribution breaks a prior promise if made; shared management renegotiates it by consent. Carry the actual agreement and remaining water forward.
Episode 4 confirms a valid Episode 3 continuity snapshot before play; it preserves exact drinking water, earlier deaths, agreement, promise and An’s previous testimony.
Jonathan and An return from the crack unharmed after isolating a damaged western pipe. Its sample is for testing, never drinking supply.

Episode 4 evidence: bottle = sample and rope retained, no route; diagram = remembered/copied route and rope retained, no sample; both = sample and route, anchored rope sacrificed. Only prior anchoring unlocks both.
Jonathan respects An’s stop signal and lets her make the first record. The closed western station still sends water; its cause, the earlier voice and deep reserve remain unexplained.
Episode 5 preserves all Episode 3/4 continuity. Retained sample tests unsafe; without sample water remains untested. Map gives safe approach; without map they follow the pipe to find a route.

Episode 5 outcomes: drain sacrifices station door and lower archive for part; leave preserves door/archive but no part; inspected brace uses retained rope or permanently destroys lightsaber if rope previously lost, takes part, saves archive, requires door repair before next storm. Both return safely; recovered part repairs pipe but valve stays closed and drinking water unchanged.
Northern tower red light is new lead. Voice, deep reserve and origin of closed-station flow remain unexplained.
